description.value: Creston Food Junction is a weekday daytime cafe in downtown Creston serving breakfast, brunch, sandwiches, and burgers. It offers takeout, making it a convenient fuel stop for cyclists passing through the Creston Valley on routes connecting the Kootenays. The compact menu and midday closing time suit the rhythm of a touring day.
